reviews.text: A visit to our vets is more of a fun trip than a chore. The team are knowledgable, friendly and so nice. My boy gets loads of attention, treats, then his jabs and meds, then more treats before the visit is over. What more can a dog dad ask for? Thanks as always! : )

I took my cat to have her nails trimmed and the vet was very kind and caring with her. I was able book my appointment really quickly.This was my second visit for a nail trim and I held my cat whilst her nails were being trimmed and the vet spoke very softly and reassuringly to her.
My cat is very nervous around strangers
The vet we saw was lovely and very knowledgable

Very good service from vet Charlotte. Very happy and so was my pebbles.
Well, Pebbles being a spicy elderly cat is always grumpy at the vets but im sure she's now a little better since she knows Charlotte.

The team at the Clapham practice is outstanding. Dr. Michael Kean and his amazing assistant (whose name I sadly didn’t catch) took incredible care of my very feisty dachshund. Their patience, kindness, and calm professionalism made all the difference. I feel genuinely lucky to have such wonderful people just down the road looking after my most loved little troublemaker.
Really knowledgable and patient with our fiesty cat!
It’s gone a bit chain-y. The aftercare, follow up phone calls and general compassion is simply not what you’d expect from a costly service. Can’t fault the receptionists though who are lovely

Thor isn’t the easiest patient, so I wanted to say a huge thank you to the whole team. From the moment we arrived, everyone was calm, professional and worked together brilliantly. The teamwork between the vet and the nurses was exceptional, and despite Thor’s protests, they treated him with such kindness and compassion throughout. They made what is usually a very stressful experience much easier for both Thor and me. Thank you all for your outstanding care—I couldn’t recommend you more highly.
Taken whatever worry I had and reassured me.
Amazing friendly staff who remember your pets past and present whichever means the world.

We have applied for a Animal health certificate for travel to the EU; considering the new travel rules, the vet told us not to worry and that she would take care of everything. We encountered a problem when filling out the questionnaire and uploading the necessary documents, but after a telephone conversation with the veterinarian, we agreed that we would come personally with the necessary documentation, and she helped us with everything. On the day when we were supposed to go get the certificates, everything was explained to us nicely, what was needed and how, and every question we had was nicely explained to us. A warm recommendation to everyone who wants to travel and has doubts about what and how, the veterinarian is here to explain everything to you.
The Practice had come out of lock down running.  I am happy with the care given by the vets. Very happy. I feel that Medivet has a way to go.
We have been using the vets for years and they have looked after all our pets and supported us in the sad times with our pets.

Made it to my appointment on time, had to wait for over 10min, due to an emergency, fair enough, then spent 10min with the vet. Got charged over £70! I realise costs have gone up, but getting charged over £70 for a 10min consultation is ridiculous.

All the staff here really care. I have a dog and a cat and they've been brilliant throughout the 4 years I needed them - for big and small things. Most recently when my dog ate some grapes. t’s a great practice and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend.
“Excellent experience for our 6-month health check. The appointment was quick and easy, and all the staff were warm, friendly, and welcoming. Really pleased with the care and service provided.”
I have always had a very good experience with Medivet Clapham, thank you to the vets and nurses and receptionists
It is always a pleasure to see Guy as he is always so professional and gentle with the dog.  A good visit.
Medivet is an excellent practice with very attentive, caring staff, a highly trained team who can spot medical issues before they become advanced . Helpful and efficient, I recommend !
After several years, I continue to have an excellent experience with Medivet Clapham.  On my latest visit Laura, Andrea and Lorraine were wonderfully caring and professional.

I signed up here because of the reviews and I’m glad I did. I’ve had three experiences since signing up earlier this year, the free initial kitten check, a minor ongoing issue and a castration. All the vets have been lovely and will also respond to emails with advice rather than always suggesting an appointment. I was worried about vet costs but I feel like they’ve been very low so far and really good value for money- the first two instances were free (other than some optional costs like flea medication and supplements) and the castration actually ending up costing less than the quote. Reception is also friendly and easy to get things sorted with!

I had a very traumatic experience with Medivet on the Abberville. I brought my golden retriever in for a regular check up, during which the vet managed to be so heavy handed in her manipulation that she tore my dogs crucial ligaments- resulting in her being unable to walk.  This then meant I had to spend over 6k with another vet putting my dog through theatre and repairing the torn crucial ligaments. The vet obviously denied doing this. But I walked into the vets with a happy dog and walked out with a dog unable to walk. It was incredibly stressful and upsetting. I think  if you have a dog with sensitive hips or legs do not go near this vet. The vet that fixed my dog was amazing, so gentle with her and she was able to diagnose her within minutes just from very gently touching her. There was absolutely no need for this level of manipulation.
Lovely vets with lots of experienced staff and very friendly receptionist all ways very good with  my dog.
Very helpful
Great service, friendly, on time and clean.
The best place for my pets that I know; everyone is very professional and kind.

Dear Medivet Abeville Team,

Thank you so much for giving Keemo his booster vaccination today! Your team was incredibly polite and caring, making our visit smooth and stress-free. We truly appreciate your excellent service.
Warm regards ✨️
Keemo Moschino
Excellent service. Caring staff.

If I could give negative ratings I would. Initially the very kind receptionist made me an appointment for a stray that I found and looked in bad shape.  I asked around the neighborhood and someone claimed to feed him, there was no proof of ownership. I called to change my appointment and explained the situation  - she (different receptionist) informed me that the vet refused to see a pet if he has an alleged owner. Even after I explained how poorly he looked. If you want a true vet who cares with compassion avoid this place.

I am so thankful that I went to Streatham Hill instead - they verified that the pet was indeed a stray and was in SEVERE pain , they provided so much love and care for the poor animal in his final hours instead of dismissing an animal in need.

We’ve had a wonderful experience with Medivet Clapham — their professionalism and genuine care for our dog consistently shines through. They are always responsive, accommodating both routine check-ups and urgent appointments with ease and compassion. It’s clear they truly love the animals they care for, and we feel very lucky to have them looking after our pup.
Kind and lovely to help my sweet Murray
Staff are amazing! Well looked after dogs.
My pup loves the vet, and even tries to pull me inside when they’re closed 🤣 …
Great practice, wonderful professionals.
Great friendly vet practice. My cat is very happy!
Great professional point of care for my dogs. Special thanks to Laura Tamisari who has unfailingly always made time for us and gives the best treatment and advice!!

Greatest vet we've ever had! Not only do they remember everything about our 3 cats (!), and ask about the others when we bring one alone, they also genuinely care for every animals! They have been very supportive whenever we have taken stray cats to them (going as far as giving us toys and dry food for them) and when we had concerns about a pregnant stray in our neighbourhood - they gave us advice over the phone and guided us through what to look for and who to contact for extra help if necessary. If you live anywhere near to Medivet Clapham, register with them, they are the best!!!
My experience with them was for the first vaccination course of my pup and they were extremely helpful since my first enquiry. The vet treated my puppy really well.

Our dog's vet for 4+ years now. He loves the team and rushes to the practice (he never remembers the vaccines, only the cuddles and treats). Very happy with the services and always warmly welcome. Highly recommend
Great vet, highly recommended.
Second time bringing my kitten for vaccines and checks. Both amazing! Dr Laura was super helpful and patient with my questions, thank you so much!

Our pets have been cared for by Medivet Clapham (Cuffe Vets) for over 30 years. The current team are amazing and Dr Guy was so kind when our 17 year old cat had to be put to sleep recently. A shout out for Dr Laura as well.
Only comment is that it is expensive, but probably no more so than others owned by large chains.
Medivet Clapham is a great vet, the staff are so very friendly and my dog Tobi loves visiting them!  Highly recommended!
The receptionists and the vets we’ve seen have been so friendly and welcoming. My cat has been well cared for and I’m very comfortable leaving his care in their hands when needed
Thank you for welcoming us!

Staff are friendly and helpful, Dr is knowledgeable and goes out her way to answer any questions as well as very friendly too. You can see that every person there truly loves and cares for our pets. Highly recommended
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

It was a heartbreaking morning having to say goodbye to our cat Gina.
Thank you to Jess and Laura at Medivet to give her the peace to pass in comfort.
So much compassion and kindness to both us and our sweet old lady.
A friendly, informative and clean veterinary practice. Would recommend to anyone.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Everything as I expected
I trust Laura Tamisari with my cat, but all the staff is professional and nice.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Fabulous practice, friendly and conscientious staff who have always treated my concerns thoroughly. My dog loves visiting the practice because he’s always made such a fuss of. Really recommend.
Absolutely great customer service very professional and friendly staff. Highly recommended
